item.title: Bob Pettit, NBA Hall of Famer and its first MVP, dies at 93
item.description: Bob Pettit was an All-American at LSU before going on to the NBA, where he was an All-Star for each of his 11 seasons, all with the Hawks. He led them to the 1958 championship over the mighty Boston Celtics, the Hawks' lone title.

item.title: Falcons and Packers kick off Week 3 of NFL season
item.description: Week 3 of the NFL season kicks off on Thursday with the Atlanta Falcons heading to Wisconsin to face the Green Bay Packers. CBS Sports NFL analyst Mike Renner has more.

item.title: Trump's lavish state dinner for Chinese leader Xi Jinping underway
item.description: President Trump and first lady Melania Trump welcomed China's Xi Jinping and his wife to the White House for a state dinner on Thursday night. CBS News correspondent Natalie Brand has the latest.

item.title: Legal expert explains why judge halted Trump's media ban
item.description: A judge temporarily halted President Trump's ban on three media outlets on Thursday, citing due process concerns. CBS News legal contributor Jessica Levinson breaks down the constitutional questions.

item.title: Man wounded during 2024 Trump rally shooting in Butler County dies
item.description: One of the men who was wounded in the 2024 attempted assassination of President Trump in Butler, Pennsylvania, has died.

item.title: Trump welcomes China's Xi for state dinner at White House
item.description: President Trump is hosting Chinese President Xi Jinping for meetings and a state dinner on Thursday, as the world's two most powerful countries try to extend a tariff truce and grapple with a rivalry on advanced AI.

item.title: Sen. Thom Tillis says U.S. needs "eyes wide open" when dealing with China
item.description: North Carolina Republican Sen. Thom Tillis told CBS News on Thursday that President Trump's summit with Chinese leader Xi Jinping was "bad timing." Chris McGuire, senior fellow with the Council on Foreign Relations, joins with analysis of the talks.

item.title: Pew report shows Americans' trust in government at historic lows ahead of midterms
item.description: With only six weeks to go before the midterms, a Pew Research poll shows only 17% of Americans trust the U.S. government. Sabrina Tavernise, a writer at The New York Times, joins "The Daily Report."

item.title: Mistress testifies in trial of "American Idol" contestant charged in wife's murder
item.description: Caleb Flynn, a former "American Idol" contestant, is charged with killing his wife Ashley Flynn in February and then staging the crime scene.

item.title: Xi gifts giant pandas to U.S., continuing years of "panda diplomacy"
item.description: President Trump honored Chinese President Xi Jinping with a state dinner on Thursday. Xi announced a new gift of giant pandas, on their way to a zoo in Atlanta, part of what Xi called an "envoy of friendship" between the two nations.

item.title: Wild high-speed chase causes chaos in Florida
item.description: Police said a man broke himself out of a hospital, carjacked a woman and led authorities on a wild chase in Miami-Dade County on Thursday. Cristian Benavides reports.

item.title: Mississippi authorities work to expedite toxicology reports for Ole Miss student deaths
item.description: Mississippi authorities worked to expedite toxicology reports for two University of Mississippi students who were found dead on Monday in separate incidents. Investigators said similarly packaged kratom was found at both scenes. Lilia Luciano reports.

item.title: Stanford University apologizes for switching students' faces and races in photo
item.description: Stanford University apologized for what it called a "serious error in judgment," editing a photo of students to alter looks, race and gender. Jonathan Vigliotti reports.

item.title: GOP Sen. Thom Tillis on Trump-Xi visit: "It's a WTF moment"
item.description: The retiring North Carolina senator was critical of President Trump's reception of Chinese President Xi Jinping.

item.title: DOJ says it's moving to end more than 50 decades-old school desegregation cases
item.description: The Justice Department said Thursday it was seeking to end more than 50 long-standing consent decrees dating back decades that sought to curb unlawful racial segregation that was prevalent during the Jim Crow era.

item.title: Former Obama administration official on Trump's talks with China's Xi
item.description: President Trump hailed his friendship with China's Xi Jinping as the two met at the White House to discuss Taiwan, artificial intelligence and more on Thursday. Danny Russel, assistant secretary of state for East Asian and Pacific Affairs under former President Barack Obama, joins "The Daily Report" to analyze the visit.

item.title: Powerful nor'easter hits North Carolina, Virginia, New Jersey: "It's very scary"
item.description: A powerful nor'easter hit several states on Thursday, starting with North Carolina's Outer Banks, with surging water washing out on the main highway connecting the barrier islands. Tom Hanson reports and Rob Marciano has the forecast.

item.title: Sen. Thom Tillis calls Trump-Xi visit "a WTF moment"
item.description: Tony Dokoupil spoke with Sen. Thom Tillis of North Carolina, one of the Republicans trying to make sense of President Trump's shift toward China between his first and second terms.

item.title: Trump hosts Xi Jinping at White House, praising a "truly great friendship"
item.description: President Trump welcomed Chinese President Xi Jinping to the White House on Thursday for his first visit to Washington, D.C., in more than a decade. Weijia Jiang reports.

item.title: Oil prices back up as U.S. and Iran trade threats to expand 7-month war
item.description: As Iran responds to Trump's threat of annihilation with its own warning of a possible "new front" in the war, global oil prices are rising again.

item.title: Australia says OpenAI agent hacked government website containing healthcare data
item.description: An OpenAI agent hacked into an Australian government website containing healthcare data. Meanwhile, Anthropic's Claude could help develop new gene-editing technology. CBS News' Jo Ling Kent reports, and medical correspondent Dr. Céline Gounder has more.

item.title: Pittsburgh doctor attacked and killed while he slept, wife also stabbed
item.description: Dr. Idris Evans, a physician and medical director from UPMC Children's Hospital in Pittsburgh, was killed in an overnight stabbing.

item.title: New Trump-focused "Love Me" ad campaign paid for by taxpayers hits airwaves
item.description: Ads promoting President Trump and paid for by American taxpayers are now airing on network and national cable.

item.title: New polling from Maine, Michigan and New Hampshire shows mixed results for Democrats
item.description: New polls from Maine, Michigan, and New Hampshire show Democratic candidates in mixed positions ahead of midterms. CBS News political reporter Zak Hudak breaks it down.

item.title: Powerful nor'easter threatens millions on East Coast with power outages, flooding, more
item.description: Millions of people on the East Coast could see power outages and severe weather conditions over the weekend. Meanwhile, a tropical storm is threatening Hawaii. CBS New York chief weathercaster Lonnie Quinn has the forecast.

item.title: California passes local journalism lifeline bill amid "catastrophic collapse"
item.description: Local news has been disappearing across the U.S. for more than a decade. A newly passed bill in California aims to reverse the trend. Rebuild Local News president and founder Steve Waldman joins "The Takeout" to discuss.

item.title: California sheriff unlawfully seized ballots, state Supreme Court rules
item.description: The California Supreme Court ruled that Riverside County Sheriff Chad Bianco violated that state's election law by ordering his deputies to seize more than 650,000 ballots.

item.title: 9/24: The Takeout with Major Garrett
item.description: President Trump holds elaborate ceremony for Chinese leader Xi Jinping; journalists regain White House access after president's ban.

item.title: Why the bond market is freaking out, and what it means for your money
item.description: Investors are increasingly nervous about rising inflation, which could require the Federal Reserve to hike interest rates.

item.title: Disney is raising prices for Disney+ and Hulu. See the breakdown.
item.description: The price hikes for new subscribers are effective immediately. Existing subscribers' plans will go up next month.
